description_en: Retrieves the DTS IP addresses that must be added to the whitelists of both the source and destination databases
description_zh: 获取源库和目标库的白名单都需要添加的DTS IP地址
kebab_example: aliyun dts describe-dts-ip --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --source-endpoint-region cn-hangzhou --destination-endpoint-region cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDTSIP

parameters.description_en: The region in which the DTS task instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.description_en:
The region ID of the source instance. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).
> If the source instance is a self-managed database that has a public IP address, you can specify **ap-southeast-1** or the region ID that is geographically closest to the self-managed database.
parameters.description_zh:
源实例所属地域ID，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
> 如果源实例为有公网IP的自建数据库，则可以传入**cn-hangzhou**或者离自建数据库物理距离最近的区域ID。
